question: By introducing an index of 'reparability' ratings for appliances it is expected:

options.text: electronics repair rate will go down very soon
now purchases will be reduced completely
waste that is harming the environment will reduce considerably
that waste generation will be more or less zero

solution:
The correct answer is '**waste that is harming the environment will reduce considerably'.**
